sourceAreas.rationale: Signed membership, topology, freshness, peer convergence and published chain.
TPM proof, attestation and measured hardware trust inputs. DER roots and retained public intake metadata are trust and qualification artifacts.
Measured boot, PCR control, UKI selection, installed verity and early ESP publication.
Enrolment and durable per-host publication.
Initrd, boot-network setup, authorized disk paths and recovery interaction.
Attended owner-only boot response and path custody.
Admission-facing kernel identity, signed state and authenticated time, runtime service ordering, and local or peer lease issuance.
Scoped activation, physical fence verification, pinned controller transport and operator authority.
Pinned etcd runtime, topology-specific templates and clients, signed operational state and state floors.
Recovery procedures, staging and exchange, lost-history detection and restricted operator paths.
Terminal transitions, fresh identities and operator revocation.
Measured policy lifecycle, PCR site advance and ESP chain publication.
Offline authorization, card records, narrow token access and protected credential channels.
Physical target commissioning, host/wire probes and signed claims or fault-control tooling. Runbook evidence does not establish a current physical run.
Factory image, deployment paths, network boundaries, per-service hardening and measured systemd wiring.
